geography_rule: Count only health gains for US residents. National coverage is not required for each intervention, but organization must have genuine domestic impact. US headquarters alone is insufficient.
valuation_rule: <$100k per 10 USA QALYs means <$10k/QALY; <$1m per 10 means <$100k/QALY. Hypotheses below are qualitative opportunities to investigate, not estimated costs or likelihoods of clearing thresholds.
gift_scope_rule: Default ordinary whole-organization gift: include overhead, all portfolio activities, country allocation, donor restrictions, additionality, substitution and real room for more funding. Do not cherry-pick program economics or credit the entire coalition policy result.
existing_report_overlap_check: Read report file inventory and searched all data/**/*report.json for the 20 exact organization names (with FRAC regex); no matches. This is not a complete search of every report alias, historical source or discovery document.
provenance_note: Per-organization helper intervals below measure sequential source retrieval only. Coverage is partial: earlier generic discovery, subsequent reading/synthesis, overlap checking and final artifact composition are not assigned or divided among organizations. Batch start/end is elapsed task span, never per-report research time. Start records were persisted with apply_patch and finished with repository research-session.mjs. No modeling or independent audit claimed.
